title: Visual Lead Time: Scan 10–15 Seconds Ahead (1 City Block / Quarter-Mile on Highway)

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All vehicles in foreground lane travel same direction; no opposing faces in same lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: No car interior or steering wheel visible; only rear exteriors shown.

single_bulb_signal.note: Overhead signal shows two lit lenses: red on top and green on bottom simultaneously.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Yellow double centerline on left of blue sedan, white edge line on right; traffic on right side.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers, or words visible; plates, banners, and diamond sign are blank shapes.

scene_match.note: Blue sedan with cyan forward-vision arc one block ahead spotting brake lights, crosswalk pedestrian left, and van right matches prompt.

result.summary: Scene matches visual lead-time concept but signal violates single-bulb rule with red and green lit together, requiring REJECT.

teaching_correct.note: Forward scanning arc and early hazard detection teach 10-15 second lead correctly.

result.what_i_see: Rear view of blue sedan in foreground center with translucent cyan arc projecting forward over an urban boulevard at sunset, covering a crosswalk pedestrian on the left, stopped cars with brake lights center, and a white van on the right under a hanging traffic light.
